reason_not_confirmatory: The historical OOS period has already been observed in V1.2.4 and V1.3. V1.4 is a mechanism-discovery battery only.

data_policy.feature_matrices: reuse frozen V1.2.3 strong-M0 and Sol matrices byte-for-byte
data_policy.labels: reuse the same local frozen historical corpus semantics
data_policy.baseline_logistic_predictions: reuse frozen V1.2.4 M0 probabilities byte-for-byte when the test uses the logistic strong-M0 comparator

fixed_reference_results.RAW_ALL_V1_2_4: V1.2.4 M0 vs M0+all eligible Sol features under elastic-net logistic
fixed_reference_results.STABILITY_V1_3: V1.3 M0 vs M0+training-stable Sol subset

LLM_ONLY_LOGIT.question: Do the frozen Sol features contain standalone predictive information at all?
LLM_ONLY_LOGIT.arm1: family-specific Sol features only, 60% outer-training coverage, frozen elastic-net fitter
LLM_ONLY_LOGIT.interpretation: diagnostic feature-universe comparison, not an incremental parity claim

PCA80_LOGIT.question: Is useful Sol information hidden by collinearity/redundancy?
PCA80_LOGIT.arm1: strong M0 plus training-only PCA of eligible Sol columns retaining >=80% training variance
PCA80_LOGIT.pca: median-impute and standardize on outer training only; PCA fit outer training only; no target labels used in PCA

ORTHO_RIDGE_LOGIT.question: Do Sol features contain information orthogonal to what strong M0 already represents?
ORTHO_RIDGE_LOGIT.arm1: strong M0 plus training-only Ridge residuals of eligible standardized Sol features after prediction from eligible standardized M0
ORTHO_RIDGE_LOGIT.ridge_cv: 3-split chronological TimeSeriesSplit, reconstruction MSE only; no target labels

GOALS_MULTI_ONLY_LOGIT.question: Are the eight MULTI_DIMENSION_MATCHUP hypotheses more useful than the dominant similarity grammar?
GOALS_MULTI_ONLY_LOGIT.arm1: strong M0 plus only GOALS MULTI_DIMENSION_MATCHUP Sol columns

GOALS_SIM_ONLY_LOGIT.question: Within GOALS, is the OPPONENT_SIMILARITY_CONDITIONAL grammar the useful component?
GOALS_SIM_ONLY_LOGIT.arm1: strong M0 plus only GOALS OPPONENT_SIMILARITY_CONDITIONAL Sol columns

HGB_RAW_PARITY.question: Is the Sol information nonlinear/interaction-dependent and therefore missed by elastic-net logistic?
HGB_RAW_PARITY.arm0: strong M0 feature matrix under fixed HistGradientBoostingClassifier
HGB_RAW_PARITY.arm1: identical HGB machinery on strong M0 plus all eligible Sol columns
HGB_RAW_PARITY.calibration: 3-split chronological OOF isotonic fit inside each outer training fold; clip [0.01,0.99]

shared_rules.within_test_family_multiplicity: Holm-Bonferroni across the applicable fixed families
shared_rules.cross_test_multiplicity: no confirmatory cross-test claim; report all tests as exploratory scorecard

interpretation.goal: identify which mechanism, if any, deserves a newly frozen prospective experiment
